Senior Business Analyst /

Product owner

Core Competencies

▪ Requirement elicitation techniques. ▪ Client relationship management ▪ Business requirement, Stake holder requirement, Solution requirement, Requirement coverage,Feature list,

Worked on Message queue , Apache kakfa

and API integrations.

Professional Background

▪ CSPO®-certified Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner with 8+ years of experience in channeling client needs and defining product vision. ▪ Experienced in using AI tools for BA activities. ▪ Experienced in providing business solutions to solve complex problems. ▪ Expertise in requirement gathering. ▪ Strong experience in handling projects based on Agile methodologies. ▪ Hands on experience in creating documentations. ▪ Worked on projects developed from scratch to go-live.

Education

▪ UG - B.E – Computer Science – Crescent Engineering College - Anna university Affiliated – Chennai Year of pass out - 2011

Email id: jayaganeshj1702@gmail.com

Ph no. : +91 9840485896

▪ PG – MBA – Marketing and HR - Vels university – Chennai Year of pass out - 2015

Trainings/ Certification

▪ CSPO® certified by Scrum Alliance ▪ ISO 20022 Payments Message ▪ Power BI

Project Highlights Payroll: TCS Role : Senior Business Analyst Tenure: July 2026

Payroll: Capgemini India PVT LTD Role: Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner - Payments / Retail and Institutional Domain / Balance and Transaction reporting. Client: ANZ Bank (Australia and New Zealand Bank) Tenure: March 2022 – June 2026

▪ Experienced in conducting requirement-gathering sessions with stakeholders. ▪ Proficient in defining product vision and roadmap, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, backlog

refinement/grooming, involved in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.

▪ Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE process mapping to identify process gaps, bottlenecks, and optimization

opportunities across business processes.

▪ Created Business Process Maps (BPMN), workflow diagrams, and process flow documentation using

Visio/BPMN for business and technical stakeholders.

▪ Performed Business Process Analysis, Gap Analysis, and Impact Assessment to support digital

transformation and process improvement initiatives.

▪ Facilitated process mapping workshops with business stakeholders to gather requirements and define

future-state business processes.

▪ Documented current-state and future-state workflows, ensuring alignment with business objectives

and technical solution design.

▪ Collaborated with Product Owners, SMEs, Architects, and Development teams to translate business

process flows into functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

▪ Identified process inefficiencies and recommended process re-engineering and workflow automation

to improve operational efficiency.

▪ Developed end-to-end business process flows for payment processing, API integrations, and cross-

functional system interactions.

▪ Ensured process compliance with business rules, regulatory requirements, and organizational

standards while validating proposed process changes.

▪ Supported UAT and implementation by validating redesigned business processes and ensuring successful

adoption of future-state workflows. ▪ Created BRD , FRD and NFR documents ▪ Created product backlog items, epics, user stories, and defined clear acceptance Criteria. ▪ Supported the design and implementation of the Target Operating Model (TOM) by aligning business

processes, operating procedures, and functional capabilities with strategic business objectives.

▪ Acted as primary liaison for SWIFT messaging business and functional requirements.

▪ Analyzed and documented SWIFT MT/MX message formats and ISO 20022 migration needs. ▪ Worked on cross-border payment schemes like SEPA / SWIFT messages - MT and MX (PAIN, PACS, CAMT). ▪ Worked on GPP payment engine initiatives supporting domestic and cross-border payment processing across SWIFT MT/MX and ISO 20022 message standards. ▪ Worked extensively across retail banking domains including CASA, Term Deposits,Loans, and Cards. ▪ Coordinated with System Integration Testing (SIT) partners. ▪ Worked extensively across retail banking domains including CASA, Term Deposits, Loans, and Cards. ▪ Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensured validation of business needs. ▪ Experience working with SOAP and REST APIs. ▪ Defined and monitored Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure product ▪ success. ▪ Familiar with the SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) methodology. ▪ Contributed to an AI-assisted initiative aimed at accelerating legacy service migration and platform modernization using Claude Sonnet 4.6 LLM.

Previous Experiences

Capgemini | Cognitive Automation and Machine learning (CAML) : Client ANZ Bank

▪ Involved in preparation of Business requirement, stake holder requirement, solution

requirement (functional and non-functional), requirement coverage.

▪ Created wife frame for Appian tool to accommodate the new features. ▪ Preparation of UML diagrams (Sequence, Class and Use case) ▪ Creation of JIRA tickets for each story, update Acceptance criteria and map it to

EPIC.

▪ NFR documentation focuses mainly on the newly created feature. ▪ Prioritisation and accommodate the Product backlog to the sprint backlog with the

Product owner.

▪ Ensuring that the user stories satisfy the Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. ▪ Streamlined a critical operational process, reducing execution time from 6 hours to 20 minutes by

identifying bottlenecks and driving automation initiatives with engineering and data teams.

▪ Enabled 70%+ time savings, significantly improving team productivity and

accelerating delivery timelines for downstream stakeholders.

Photon Interactive Pvt ltd | L’Oreal| E-commerce and Retail Domain |Sitecore

CMS 8.1 & 8.2 - Senior Product Analyst - Apr 2018 - March 2022

▪ Managed websites by tracking incidents and feature enhancements within defined

SLAs.

▪ Gathered requirements for creation of new components in Sitecore CMS.

▪ Provided complete Sitecore CMS training to the Business content editor so that they

can modify the contents and handle Sitecore.

▪ Provided support to the content editors to clarify the queries on Sitecore. ▪ Documentation of the user stories that grooms up as a part of the Feature level enhancements ▪ Implemented features using Agile methodology, handling both in-scope and out-of-

scope requirements

Santander| Banking | Loan management system - Business Analyst ▪ Played a major role by acting as a bridge between the client end and the

development team.

————————————————————————————————————————

—BPM
